messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking"
set: ["tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking", "inform healthcare provider about all medical conditions", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "tell doctor about all medical conditions and drugs used", "tell healthcare providers about all medicines used", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "healthcare provider", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "certain medical conditions", "other medical conditions", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "keep all follow-up visits with healthcare provider"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
